oscillation_proxy: answer_changes + committed_aba_count + retractions; retractions count all V4 events, including rejected/intermediate events
answer_changes: adjacent changes among committed unrejected normalized integer claims; not semantic reasoning switching
repetition: existing 4/8/16 token ngrams; count duplicates / total ngrams and unique / total
nonzero_indicator: mechanical zero/nonzero description only; no validated failure threshold
repetition_classification: paired relative comparison only; no new n/window/threshold
first_committed_claim: integer answer VALUE, not a position; position is first_committed_claim_char
missing_reason: Existing summaries lack token-to-character offsets, per-event final retraction labels and validated semantic flip/long-span taxonomy; no new extraction or thresholds introduced.
